Q6052.reason: A mandatory-sounding presumption instruction without explaining it is permissive/rebuttable risks shifting the burden of proof on an element, violating due process (Sandstrom/Francis v. Franklin).

Q6054.reason: Implied easement by necessity arises over the grantee's land when a grantor severs and leaves a parcel landlocked, regardless of alternative offers from neighbors that require purchase.

Q6057.reason: Standard mercury and aneroid sphygmomanometer scales are graduated in 2 mmHg increments.
